add.issue.name: Browser screenshot: scale omits the 1/DPR factor on mobile/tablet presets

edit.description.md: Found by the PR #14 re-review; it was already in the base commit. On presets with devicePixelRatio 2, the viewport screenshot's returned `fit` scale omits the 1/DPR clip factor, so the bitmap is off from the reported scale by the DPR factor (src/server/browser/page.ts, viewport branch). Fix it and pin it with a browser.test.ts case on a DPR-2 preset.

add.issue.name: Flaky test: visible-models-ui "the owner's switches decide which models the model menu offers"

edit.description.md: test/visible-models-ui.test.ts:197. It passes and fails on the same code (seen on cleanup-pr12/pr13 on 2026-10-13, and it passes alone on origin/oh-my-pocket). When it fails, the menu list has an extra 'standard on no model yet' entry: the built-in Standard router shows up in the model menu, depending on timing. Either the test should wait for the router list to settle, or it should expect the router entry.
